tableRoles.note: This sheet is the master library, so these roles point at ITS OWN tables (reflexive) rather than referencing another sheet. A plan sheet whose own printed tables are confirmed byte-identical to these can point its own tableRoles entries at {'refSheet':'619-011','table':'011-0N'} instead of re-transcribing -- see knownExcerpts below for which 619-311 tables are already confirmed this way. IMPORTANT ASYMMETRY: 619-311's combined 'taperAndBuffer' role (one table, 311-02, holding both taper AND buffer) does not exist on this sheet -- 619-011 keeps taper (011-02) and buffer (011-03) as two separate tables. mcp-server/sheet_spec.py's resolve() currently expects the 311-02-style combined shape; a sheet that wants to reference 619-011's split tables directly (rather than reprinting a local combined table like 311 does) will need resolve() extended to merge two table sources. Not built here -- no current sheet needs it yet, and building it speculatively risks guessing the wrong merge shape. Flagged for whoever authors the first sheet that needs it.

011-01.title: PROTECTIVE VEHICLE REQUIREMENTS
011-01.note: The master table. 619-311's tables['311-01'] is exactly this table's SHORT_TERM / NON-FREEWAY columns -- confirmed cell-for-cell identical during transcription (every LANE/SHOULDER x WORKERS/OTHER row, SHORT_TERM block, matches 311-01's 4 rows x 3 non-freeway speed columns exactly). durations covered here that 311-01 does NOT have: MOBILE, SHORT_DURATION, INTERMEDIATE_TERM, LONG_TERM -- these matter for STATUS.md's Family 1 duration variants (619-412/414/423/523 = Intermediate/Long Term siblings of 311's family) and should be sourced from here rather than re-transcribed.

durationDefinitions.MOBILE: Work that moves intermittently or continuously, where the work at any specific location completes within 15 minutes. Includes "stop and go" operations of 5 minutes or less.
durationDefinitions.SHORT_DURATION: Work that occupies a location for up to 1 hour.
durationDefinitions.SHORT_TERM: Daytime work that occupies a location for more than 1 hour within a single daylight period.
durationDefinitions.INTERMEDIATE_TERM: Work that occupies a location more than one daylight period up to 3 consecutive days or night time work lasting more than 1 hour.
durationDefinitions.LONG_TERM: Work that occupies a location for more than 3 consecutive days.

011-02.title: TAPER LENGTHS & NUMBER OF CONES CHART

columnMeaning.laneTaper: TAPER LENGTH: L (FT.)/ # OF SKIP LINES/ # OF CHANNELIZING DEVICES, FOR LATERAL SHIFT OF TRAFFIC FLOW PATH (FT.) 4 THROUGH 12
columnMeaning.shoulderTaper: SHOULDER TAPER LENGTH: L/3 (FT.)/ # OF SKIP LINES/ # OF CHANNELIZING DEVICES, FOR SHOULDER WIDTH

011-02.note: Wider than any single plan sheet's own taper table: 9 speed rows (25-65, in 5mph steps -- includes 60 and 65, which 619-311's own 311-02 does NOT cover) and 9 lateral-shift columns (4-12 ft, vs 311-02's 3: 10/11/12). Confirmed identical to 619-311.json tables['311-02'] on every overlapping cell (speeds 25-55, lateral shift 10/11/12, all 3 shoulder bands) during transcription -- 0 mismatches.

knownAnomalies.issue: 800 ft implies 20 skip lines (800/40), not the printed 19 -- every other cell on this table satisfies ft = skipLines * 40 exactly, including the adjacent shift-11 cell (720/18/19, 18*40=720). Re-verified twice directly against the PDF's vector text (not a transcription slip). This is an inconsistency printed on the actual sheet. Transcribed as printed per the verbatim rule -- do not silently correct it. scripts/validate_sheet_spec.py's skip-line invariant will flag this one cell; that is expected and should stay visible, not be suppressed.
knownAnomalies.recommendation: A caller resolving speed=65/lateralShift=12 should decide explicitly whether to trust ft=800 or skipLines=19 (devices=20 is internally consistent with skipLines=19 via devices=skips+1, so devices/skipLines agree with each other -- only ft is the outlier).

footnotes: * THIS TABLE WAS CREATED WITH REFERENCE TO MUTCD TABLE 6H-4.
** THE NUMBER OF CHANNELIZING DEVICES SHOWN IS CALCULATED BASED ON A 40FT DEVICE SPACING. THE NUMBER OF CHANNELIZING DEVICES CAN BE ADJUSTED AS NECESSARY.

011-04.title: ROLL AHEAD DISTANCE FOR PROTECTIVE VEHICLES
011-04.columnMeaning: ROLL AHEAD DISTANCE (FT.)/# OF SKIP LINES FOR VEHICLES, both MOVING OPERATION (based on protective vehicle speed of 15 MPH) and STATIONARY OPERATION, each MIN and MAX
011-04.footnote: *THIS TABLE WAS CREATED WITH REFERENCE TO MUTCD TABLES NY-2 AND NY2-B.
011-04.note: STATIONARY columns confirmed identical to 619-311.json tables['311-04'] on all 3 speed bands -- 0 mismatches. MOVING OPERATION columns are new data 619-311 does not carry (it only ever needed stationary).
011-04.usageNote: Both operation types give a MIN and a MAX, not a single value. A plan must choose a value in the range and be able to justify it.
